required_facts.claim: Search, or retrieval, is one of the most important parts of RAG.
required_facts.source_evidence: Search, or retrieval, is one of the most important parts of RAG.

required_facts.claim: I needed a way to teach it without asking participants to install Docker or Elasticsearch.
required_facts.source_evidence: I needed a way to teach it without asking participants to install Docker or Elasticsearch.

required_facts.claim: So I built [minsearch]: a small in-process Python search library.
required_facts.source_evidence: So I built [minsearch]: a small in-process Python search library.

required_facts.claim: It started as the smallest thing I needed to teach retrieval in a notebook, then grew as the course examples changed.
